chemical_formula.description: The standard chemical formula of the material (e.g., ZrO2, Al2O3, Fe3O4, Ti0.5Al0.5N). Do NOT leave empty.

composition.description: The composition in the format Element:ratio,Element:ratio (e.g., Zr:1,O:2; Ti:0.5,Al:0.5,N:1). Do NOT leave empty.

n_sites.description: Number of crystallographic sites (e.g., 4, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

elements.description: Comma-separated list of element symbols (e.g., Zr,O; Ti,Al,N)

lattice_parameter.description: Lattice parameters with units, preserving the exact format from the text (e.g., a=5.191, b=5.239, c=5.392; a=b=c=4.05)

space_group.description: Space group notation (e.g., P2_1/c, P4_2/nmc, Fm-3m, P6_3/mmc, R-3c)

crystal_system.description: Crystal system name (e.g., monoclinic, tetragonal, cubic, hexagonal, orthorhombic, trigonal, triclinic)

symmetry_symbol.description: Symmetry symbol or Hermann–Mauguin notation. Leave empty if not mentioned

number_of_elements.description: Total number of different elements (same as n_elements)

number_of_atoms.description: Total number of atoms in the unit cell (e.g., 3, 5, 8, 12). Leave empty if not mentioned

density.description: Density value with units if provided (e.g., 5.68 g/cm³). Leave empty if not mentioned

supercell_size.description: Supercell dimensions if mentioned (e.g., 2×2×2, 3×3×1). Leave empty if not mentioned

volume.description: Unit cell volume with units if provided (e.g., 145.2 Å³). Leave empty if not mentioned

note.description: Additional important structural information not covered by other fields (e.g., m-ZrO2, high-pressure phase, metastable phase)
